knowledge_gaps: Similarity support measures embedding density, not recurrence directly. Popular items or broad clusters could receive greater weight, reinforcing the diagnosed failure. Compare against simple recency pooling and a popularity-controlled support variant before adding more complex architectures.

Capping the gate at 0.5 does not bound the residual contribution: the projection and item embeddings can grow arbitrarily. Specify normalization or an explicit relative-norm bound, and define initialization precisely.

Reproduction requires explicit top-k handling for short prefixes, temperature, embedding normalization, support-gradient behavior, optimizer settings, checkpoint selection, and padding-safe pooling. All-masked attention and top-k entries must not produce NaNs or artificial support.

User-specific negative exclusion is underspecified because the diagnostic-compatible loader yields no user IDs. Specify how the training sampler retains user identity, handles duplicate negatives, and terminates when too few eligible items remain. Clarify whether the loss is an uncorrected sampled-candidate objective or an approximation to full-catalog softmax.

The four-way ablation lacks a GPU-time allocation and stopping policy within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Equal epochs and equal compute answer different questions. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category also needs paired uncertainty estimates and a predefined selection rule without changing the evaluator.

Raw margins remain sensitive to embedding norms and temperature conventions, so they cannot establish improved discrimination across objectives. Full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the required 20 training users also need an explicit diagnostic procedure. The originality rating is plausible, but potential and implementation difficulty remain provisional without runtime measurements and comparison to simpler pooling baselines.
